secret_key.description: File to read the secret key from. If not given, reads from standard-input.

pubring.description: File to read public key information from. Required when rebuilding private keys.

secrets_file.description: File to read the extracted secrets (paperkey) from. If not given, reads from standard-input.

output_file.description: Redirect output to the file given instead of printing to standard-output.

output_type.description: Select the output type. The base16 style encodes the information in hex-dump style. Raw mode is for barcode generators.

input_type.description: Specify that the given input is either in base16 format, as produced by paperkey, or in raw format. Default auto tries to automatically detect the format.

output_width.description: Choose line width in the base16 output mode. The default is 78 characters.

verbose.description: Print status and progress information to standard-error while processing the input.

ignore_crc_error.description: Do not reject corrupt input and continue despite any CRC errors.

comment.description: Include the specified comment in the base16 output.

file_format.description: Simply prints out the file format and exits successfully.
